# Filter replacement

The filter removes dirt from the fluid. A blocked filter decreases the flow of
fluid to the pump. Replace the filter every 500 hours.

## Procedure

1. Set the system to OFF.
2. Turn the drain valve counterclockwise.
3. Remove the filter bowl.
4. Install the new filter.
5. Tighten the filter bowl to 20 Nm.

The pump makes a noise if the filter is not correct. Look at the pressure gauge.
